channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Can Yemen’s government forces sustain their offensive against the Houthis?
item.description: Houthi missile strikes threaten key supply routes on Yemen's Red Sea coast, intensifying pressure on government forces.

item.title: Russian attacks in Ukraine kill at least 8, cut power to 1 million
item.description: Russia strikes Kharkiv, Kramatorsk, Volyn and Rivne as Moscow presses its campaign against Ukraine's power grid.

item.title: Healthcare crisis escalating in Yemen’s besieged Taiz
item.description: Fighting between Yemen’s Houthis and the internationally recognised government is deepening the humanitarian crisis.

item.title: Oregon school shooter was former special needs student, police say
item.description: A teacher fought teenage shooter and a parent shot him dead, police say on Friday, a day after four people were killed.

item.title: Iran war live: IRGC says supertanker hits mine in Hormuz, catches fire
item.description: Iran’s Revolutionary Guard says tanker with more than 2 million barrels of crude on board taking 'unauthorised' route.

item.title: Three men jailed for 158 years each for murdering Australian and US surfers in Mexico
item.description: Brothers Jake and Callum Robinson and their friend Carter Rhoad were killed on a surfing trip in an apparent botched robbery.

item.title: Palestinians and US journalist injured by Israeli settlers in West Bank harvest attack
item.description: The BBC sees masked settlers attack Palestinians trying to harvest olives, amid a surge in similar incidents.

item.title: Albanian protests turn violent: What we know
item.description: Albania's capital Tirana has seen months of protests from an anti-government "Flamingo" movement, but what started on Tuesday this week was on a different scale.

item.title: 'It's really hard to believe' - How Oregon primary school shooting unfolded
item.description: Three children aged 5, 8 and 11 and a teacher were killed after a 16-year-old suspect opened fire in the city of Bend, local police say.

item.title: Israeli settlers attack Palestinians in West Bank during olive harvest
item.description: Israeli settlers were seen attacking Palestinian farmers and setting fire to olive trees in the West Bank.
